title: ID0416398-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / R5 170001902] outlet1 is out of service
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Outlet 1 out of order due to “could not configure slac” error in EcoG
Solution:
Apply EcoG hotfix 1.4.11

additional_info.subject: Ticket 0416398 has been closed. Are you satisfied with our provided solution? CRM:00315002503
